caption:
Weakness upon weakness: what your mother carried

Allah reminds us that a mother carries her child in weakness upon weakness, and He tells us to be grateful to Him and to our parents. Call them tonight, or make dua for them if they have passed.

Surah Luqman 31:14

Send this to your mother with one word: thank you.

#mother #kindnesstoparents #surahluqman #muslimfamily

Recitation: Abdul Basit Abdus-Samad
alt_text: We have enjoined upon man kindness to his parents. His mother bore him in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning took place within two years. Be grateful to Me and to your parents. To Me is the final return (Surah Luqman 31:14)
